status: SPG(M3)/(M5) UNIFIED NS EoS (crust+core) RECEIVED AND PARSED; E_sym TRAJECTORY EXTRACTED; PER-MODEL 12-COUPLING EXTRACTION CONFIRMED UNDERDETERMINED FROM BETA-EQUIL-ONLY EXPORT
node: M3-j (unified SPG(M3)/(M5) CompOSE export - core-inclusive, E_sym trajectory extraction)
summary: The researcher provided the unified (crust+core) CompOSE exports for SPG(M3) and SPG(M5), named 'SPG(M3) unified NS EoS.zip' and 'SPG(M5) unified NS EoS.zip'. Unlike the crust-only 317/319 exports from M3-i (which stopped at 0.045 rho_sat), these extend to rho_B = 0.977 fm^-3 (5.5 rho_sat), covering the full core region. Both were extracted and parsed through the native reader. The inner crust F(rho) of each unified export matches the corresponding crust-only 317/319 export EXACTLY (max |dF| = 0.0000 MeV at 12 matched densities), confirming the crust-only exports are subsets of the unified exports. From the beta-equilibrated F(rho, Yp) trajectory in the core region, the E_sym(rho) trajectory was extracted using the parabolic approximation E_sym(rho) = mu_e(rho, Yp) / (4*(1 - 2*Yp)) with mu_e = hbar*(3*pi^2*rho*Yp)^(1/3). The per-model E_sym at rho_sat = 0.178 fm^-3 is M3 = 39.48 MeV, M5 = 38.78 MeV, both approximately 7-8 MeV HIGHER than the canonical Gögelein-basis solver value of 31.40 MeV, indicating both M3 and M5 have stiffer symmetry energy than the Scurto prior center (canonical Gögelein couplings). The L_sym proxy (slope of E_sym around rho_sat) is M3 ~ 62.5 MeV, M5 ~ 71.2 MeV (canonical target L = 73 MeV); M5 is close to canonical L while M3 has a lower L, consistent with M3 being the high-max-mass extreme (stiffer symmetry energy and lower L give a more massive NS). The 12 per-model coupling parameters (a, b, c, d per meson) cannot be uniquely determined from the unified export alone: the system is UNDERDETERMINED - the beta-equil trajectory provides only one Yp per rho, constraining 6 NMPs (E_sat, K_sat, J, L, K_sym, M*/M) but not the 12 couplings. Symmetric-matter E_SN(rho) cannot be reliably extracted from the beta-equil trajectory via the parabolic approximation because delta ~ 0.88 (very neutron-rich) amplifies E_sym*delta^2 errors, producing unreliable E_sat/K_sat estimates. To fully unblock per-model coupling extraction the researcher would need to provide (a) a Yp = 0.5 symmetric-matter cut from the same models, (b) the numeric coupling tables behind Scurto 2024 Fig. 19, or (c) a multi-Yp F(rho, Yp) surface fit. The extracted E_sym trajectories are recorded in the JSON for consistency checking and future isovector-coupling retuning.

unified_exports_received.consistency_with_crust_only_317_319: EXACT MATCH - inner crust F(rho) of unified M3 matches crust-only 317 with max |dF| = 0.0000 MeV at 12 matched densities (rho in [3e-3, 7e-2]). The crust-only exports are subsets of the unified exports. This validates the M3-i inner-crust comparison and the unified export's integrity.

esym_trajectory_extraction.method: parabolic beta-equil: E_sym(rho) = mu_e(rho, Yp) / (4*(1 - 2*Yp)), mu_e = hbar*(3*pi^2*rho*Yp)^(1/3). Valid where Yp is not too small and the parabolic approximation holds (rho <= 0.30 fm^-3).

SPG_M3.high_density_behavior: E_sym rises to 49.4 at rho=0.30, then plateaus (M3 stiffer at moderate density, saturating at high density)

SPG_M5.high_density_behavior: E_sym rises steeply at rho>0.25 (M5 = 53.8 at rho=0.30 vs M3 = 49.4), consistent with the extreme proton-fraction tail - softer at moderate density but steeper high-density growth

M3_vs_M5_physical_distinguishing_feature.L_sym: M3 = 62.5, M5 = 71.2 (M3 lower L -> more massive NS)
M3_vs_M5_physical_distinguishing_feature.interpretation: M3 = high-max-mass extreme (stiffer E_sym, lower L, more massive NS); M5 = extreme proton-fraction tail (softer moderate-density E_sym, steeper high-density growth, larger clusters, earlier transition). Both differ from canonical by +7-8 MeV in J_sym, indicating the Scurto prior center (canonical Gögelein couplings) underestimates the posterior-selected models' symmetry energy.

canonical_reconstruction_vs_unified_inne.method: compare read_compose F(rho) for our canonical-basis SPG_M1 reconstruction (download/reconstruction/SPG_M1) vs unified SPG(M3)/(M5) inner crust (Iphase=7)
canonical_reconstruction_vs_unified_inne.interpretation: Agreement within 1.5 MeV across the inner crust. Best agreement at rho <= 0.03 (within 0.7 MeV); the canonical Gögelein basis reproduces the unified M3/M5 inner crust well. M5 remains closer to canonical at the transition (dF_M5 = -0.39 MeV at rho=0.08) than M3 (dF_M3 = -1.11 MeV), confirming M5 is closer to the Scurto prior center.

coupling_extraction_undetermined.issue: The unified export provides the BETA-EQUILIBRATED trajectory only - one Yp(rho) per rho_B. This trajectory constrains 6 NMPs (E_sat, K_sat, J_sym, L_sym, K_sym, M*/M) but the SPG GDFM model has 12 coupling parameters (a, b, c, d per meson, with d=0 for omega and rho giving effectively 10 free parameters). The system is underdetermined: many coupling combinations produce the same beta-equil trajectory.
coupling_extraction_undetermined.symmetric_matter_extraction_problem: Symmetric-matter E_SN(rho) = E(rho, delta=0) cannot be reliably extracted from the beta-equil trajectory because delta ~ 0.88 (very neutron-rich) at the relevant densities. The parabolic-approximation inversion E_SN = F_bind - E_sym*delta^2 amplifies the E_sym uncertainty by delta^2 ~ 0.77, producing E_sat/K_sat estimates with ~5 MeV systematic uncertainty (e.g., E_SN at rho_sat extracted as ~-12 MeV for M3/M5 vs the expected -16 MeV).
remaining_resolution_paths: (a) Researcher provides a Yp = 0.5 symmetric-matter cut of the same SPG(M3)/(M5) models - this would give E_SN(rho) directly and constrain the isoscalar couplings (sigma, omega)
(b) Researcher provides the numeric coupling tables behind Scurto 2024 Fig. 19 (the 12 a,b,c,d values per meson for each Mx model) - this is the most direct resolution
(c) Multi-Yp fit: if the researcher can export F(rho, Yp) at several fixed Yp values (not just beta-equil), a 12-parameter fit becomes well-posed
coupling_extraction_undetermined.current_status: Canonical Gögelein 2008 Table I couplings remain the common basis for all 5 SPG models. The E_sym trajectories extracted here are recorded in the JSON for (1) consistency verification of the canonical basis (passed within 1.5 MeV inner crust, +7-8 MeV E_sym offset documented), and (2) future isovector-coupling retuning when resolution paths (a)-(c) become available.
